I have completed the Feed & Discovery Audit of bainluck.com. The site has excellent mobile responsiveness and some strong data visualizations (like the Economics page), but suffers from several critical data quality issues, including a systematic bug showing 0%/100% probabilities, placeholder names in production, and incorrect game states (future games marked as "FINAL"). 

The full audit report has been compiled and is attached below, along with the requested screenshots of the home feed, mobile view, category pages, championship grids, and examples of the failed findings.
